name: 78 - API - Manage Patient Consents and Preferences - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS action,
        $2::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $3::TEXT AS mobile,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') AS consent_type,
        NULLIF($5::TEXT, '') AS policy_version,
        $6::JSONB AS scope_json,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '')::TIMESTAMPTZ AS expires_at,
        NULLIF($8::TEXT, '') AS channel,
        $9::BOOLEAN AS enabled,
        $10::TEXT AS preferred_language,
        $11::TEXT AS timezone,
        $12::BOOLEAN AS quiet_hours_enabled,
        NULLIF($13::TEXT, '')::TIME AS quiet_hours_start,
        NULLIF($14::TEXT, '')::TIME AS quiet_hours_end,
        NULLIF($15::INTEGER, 0) AS max_messages_per_week,
        $16::JSONB AS preferences,
        NULLIF($17::TEXT, '') AS actor_name,
        $18::TEXT AS source_channel,
        NULLIF($19::TEXT, '') AS reason
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        patient.id AS patient_id,
        patient.full_name,
        patient.mobile,
        request.*
    FROM request_data request
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.clinic_id = clinic.id
       AND patient.mobile = request.mobile
    LIMIT 1
),

previous_consent AS (
    SELECT
        consent.id,
        consent.status
    FROM patient_consents consent
    INNER JOIN patient_context context
        ON consent.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND consent.patient_id = context.patient_id
       AND consent.consent_type = context.consent_type
    WHERE context.action IN ('grant', 'revoke')
    LIMIT 1
),

upserted_consent AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_consents (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type,
        status,
        policy_version,
        scope_json,
        source_channel,
        granted_at,
        revoked_at,
        expires_at,
        last_actor,
        last_reason,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.patient_id,
        context.consent_type,
        CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'grant'
                THEN 'granted'
            ELSE 'revoked'
        END,
        context.policy_version,
        context.scope_json,
        context.source_channel,
        CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'grant'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'revoke'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        context.expires_at,
        context.actor_name,
        context.reason,
        NOW()
    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE context.action IN ('grant', 'revoke')
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        status = EXCLUDED.status,
        policy_version = EXCLUDED.policy_version,
        scope_json = EXCLUDED.scope_json,
        source_channel = EXCLUDED.source_channel,
        granted_at = CASE
            WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'granted'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE patient_consents.granted_at
        END,
        revoked_at = CASE
            WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'revoked'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
        last_actor = EXCLUDED.last_actor,
        last_reason = EXCLUDED.last_reason,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

inserted_consent_event AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_consent_events (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_id,
        consent_type,
        event_type,
        previous_status,
        new_status,
        actor_name,
        source_channel,
        policy_version,
        reason,
        event_payload
    )
    SELECT
        consent.clinic_id,
        consent.patient_id,
        consent.id,
        consent.consent_type,
        CASE
            WHEN consent.status = 'granted'
                THEN 'granted'
            ELSE 'revoked'
        END,
        (
            SELECT status
            FROM previous_consent
        ),
        consent.status,
        context.actor_name,
        context.source_channel,
        context.policy_version,
        context.reason,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'scope',
                consent.scope_json,
            'expires_at',
                consent.expires_at
        )
    FROM upserted_consent consent
    CROSS JOIN patient_context context
    RETURNING id
),

ensured_profile AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_profiles (
        patient_id
    )
    SELECT
        context.patient_id
    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE context.action IN ('grant', 'revoke')
    ON CONFLICT (patient_id)
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING patient_id
),

synced_profile AS (
    UPDATE patient_profiles profile
    SET
        consent_to_contact = CASE
            WHEN context.consent_type = 'contact'
                THEN context.action = 'grant'
            ELSE profile.consent_to_contact
        END,

        consent_to_store_profile = CASE
            WHEN context.consent_type = 'profile_storage'
                THEN context.action = 'grant'
            ELSE profile.consent_to_store_profile
        END,

        consent_to_store_documents = CASE
            WHEN context.consent_type = 'document_storage'
                THEN context.action = 'grant'
            ELSE profile.consent_to_store_documents
        END,

        privacy_notice_version = COALESCE(
            context.policy_version,
            profile.privacy_notice_version
        ),

        privacy_notice_accepted_at = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'grant'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE profile.privacy_notice_accepted_at
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE profile.patient_id = context.patient_id
      AND context.action IN ('grant', 'revoke')
    RETURNING profile.patient_id
),

single_preference AS (
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.patient_id,
        context.channel,
        context.enabled,
        context.preferred_language,
        context.timezone,
        context.quiet_hours_enabled,
        context.quiet_hours_start,
        context.quiet_hours_end,
        context.max_messages_per_week,
        '{}'::JSONB AS metadata,
        context.actor_name AS updated_by
    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE context.action = 'set_preference'
),

bulk_preferences AS (
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.patient_id,
        LOWER(item ->> 'channel') AS channel,
        COALESCE(
            (item ->> 'enabled')::BOOLEAN,
            TRUE
        ) AS enabled,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(item ->> 'preferred_language', ''),
            context.preferred_language
        ) AS preferred_language,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(item ->> 'timezone', ''),
            context.timezone
        ) AS timezone,
        COALESCE(
            (item ->> 'quiet_hours_enabled')::BOOLEAN,
            FALSE
        ) AS quiet_hours_enabled,
        NULLIF(item ->> 'quiet_hours_start', '')::TIME
            AS quiet_hours_start,
        NULLIF(item ->> 'quiet_hours_end', '')::TIME
            AS quiet_hours_end,
        NULLIF(
            (item ->> 'max_messages_per_week')::INTEGER,
            0
        ) AS max_messages_per_week,
        COALESCE(
            item -> 'metadata',
            '{}'::JSONB
        ) AS metadata,
        context.actor_name AS updated_by
    FROM patient_context context
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(
        context.preferences
    ) AS item
    WHERE context.action = 'set_preferences'
),

preference_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM single_preference
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM bulk_preferences
),

upserted_preferences AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_communication_preferences (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel,
        enabled,
        preferred_language,
        timezone,
        quiet_hours_enabled,
        quiet_hours_start,
        quiet_hours_end,
        max_messages_per_week,
        metadata,
        updated_by,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        row.clinic_id,
        row.patient_id,
        row.channel,
        row.enabled,
        row.preferred_language,
        row.timezone,
        row.quiet_hours_enabled,
        row.quiet_hours_start,
        row.quiet_hours_end,
        row.max_messages_per_week,
        row.metadata,
        row.updated_by,
        NOW()
    FROM preference_rows row
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled,
        preferred_language =
            EXCLUDED.preferred_language,
        timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone,
        quiet_hours_enabled =
            EXCLUDED.quiet_hours_enabled,
        quiet_hours_start =
            EXCLUDED.quiet_hours_start,
        quiet_hours_end =
            EXCLUDED.quiet_hours_end,
        max_messages_per_week =
            EXCLUDED.max_messages_per_week,
        metadata =
            patient_communication_preferences.metadata
            || EXCLUDED.metadata,
        updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

inserted_preference_events AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_consent_events (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type,
        event_type,
        actor_name,
        source_channel,
        reason,
        event_payload
    )
    SELECT
        preference.clinic_id,
        preference.patient_id,
        'contact',
        'preference_changed',
        context.actor_name,
        context.source_channel,
        context.reason,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'channel',
                preference.channel,
            'enabled',
                preference.enabled,
            'preferred_language',
                preference.preferred_language,
            'timezone',
                preference.timezone,
            'quiet_hours_enabled',
                preference.quiet_hours_enabled
        )
    FROM upserted_preferences preference
    CROSS JOIN patient_context context
    RETURNING id
),

consent_list AS (
    SELECT
        consent.id,
        consent.consent_type,
        consent.status,
        consent.policy_version,
        consent.scope_json,
        consent.source_channel,
        consent.granted_at,
        consent.revoked_at,
        consent.expires_at,
        consent.last_actor,
        consent.last_reason,
        consent.updated_at
    FROM patient_consents consent
    INNER JOIN patient_context context
        ON consent.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND consent.patient_id = context.patient_id
    ORDER BY consent.consent_type
),

preference_list AS (
    SELECT
        preference.id,
        preference.channel,
        preference.enabled,
        preference.preferred_language,
        preference.timezone,
        preference.quiet_hours_enabled,
        preference.quiet_hours_start,
        preference.quiet_hours_end,
        preference.max_messages_per_week,
        preference.metadata,
        preference.updated_by,
        preference.updated_at
    FROM patient_communication_preferences preference
    INNER JOIN patient_context context
        ON preference.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND preference.patient_id = context.patient_id
    ORDER BY preference.channel
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN request.action IN ('grant', 'revoke')
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM upserted_consent
         )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN request.action IN (
            'set_preference',
            'set_preferences'
        )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM upserted_preferences
         )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN 'patient_not_found'

        WHEN request.action = 'grant'
            THEN 'patient_consent_granted'

        WHEN request.action = 'revoke'
            THEN 'patient_consent_revoked'

        WHEN request.action = 'set_preference'
            THEN 'communication_preference_updated'

        WHEN request.action = 'set_preferences'
            THEN 'communication_preferences_updated'

        ELSE 'patient_consents_and_preferences_loaded'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT patient_id
        FROM patient_context
    ) AS patient_id,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(consent)
            )
            FROM consent_list consent
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS consents,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(preference)
            )
            FROM preference_list preference
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS preferences,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM upserted_preferences
        ),
        0
    ) AS preferences_affected,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_consent_event
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS consent_event_id

FROM request_data request;

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{success:false,result:'invalid_request',message:'اطلاعات رضایت یا ترجیحات ارتباطی نامعتبر است.',errors:$json.errors||[]}}];

## مدیریت متمرکز رضایت

اقدام‌ها:
- get
- grant
- revoke
- set_preference
- set_preferences

تغییرات رضایت و ترجیح کانال به‌صورت رویداد قابل‌ممیزی ثبت می‌شوند.
